paragraphs: Rav Achai. “Rav Achai objects”: Yevamot, chapter 2, 24a; Shevuat Haddayyanim; first chapter of Kiddushin 13a; Bekhorot 6, beginning of a; Ketubbot 47a; Ellu Tereifot 65b; Niddah 33a. Some say he is one of the savoraim (who composed the She'iltot), but on “Rav Achai resolves,” Ketubbot 2b, Tosafot write he was an amora in Rav Ashi’s time (Tosafot, Zevachim 102b). Each amora uses his characteristic expression: “Rabbi Abbahu scoffs” (see there); “Rabbi Yochanan wonders at it”; “Abaye curses over it.” “Rav Achai considers it,” Bekhorot 5a; “Rabbi Achai answers,” Ketubbot 10a.
